description: This header file declares functions related to WebPA notification configuration, including setting configuration files, retrieving parameter lists, and getting notification source. It is part of a larger source code base handling WebPA parameter request processing.

methods.name: setNotifyConfigurationFile
methods.description: Initializes WebPA configuration file with a specified filename.

methods.name: getnotifyparamList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of WebPA notification parameters and its size.

methods.name: getNotifySource
methods.description: Obtains the WebPA notification source string.
